label: Drought Monitor
title: US Drought Monitor
subtitle: Weekly map valid 30 Dec 2025, official US drought categories
source: US Drought Monitor, National Drought Mitigation Center (University of Nebraska-Lincoln), USDA and NOAA

categories.label: No drought area
categories.note: under 25% of the parish in D0 or worse

rank.high: Most area in drought (D1 or worse)
rank.note: Ranked by the share of the parish in D1 or worse.

how: Each parish is coloured by the worst Drought Monitor category that covers at least 25% of its area, from the latest weekly map. The pop-up shows the share of the parish in each category and the last 12 weeks. The Drought Monitor is drawn by experts and is a separate source from the other layers.
limits: Experts draw it from many sources, including local reports, so it can differ from the other layers on this page.
Only a category covering 25% or more of the parish sets the colour. A smaller area in a worse category shows only in the pop-up.
It is a weekly map valid on Tuesdays and released on Thursdays. It reflects the weeks before, mostly long-term dryness.
It is not a forecast and does not describe single fields.

credits.text: US Drought Monitor, National Drought Mitigation Center at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln, the USDA and NOAA
Parish boundaries: US Census Bureau cartographic boundary files (public domain)
